items.title: NBA names Kalshi and Polymarket preferred prediction market exchanges and signs CFTC integrity pact, CDC Gaming reports
items.content_text: - **NBA names Kalshi and Polymarket preferred prediction market exchanges and signs CFTC integrity pact, CDC Gaming reports** — The NBA on Monday designated Kalshi and Polymarket as its preferred prediction market exchanges and signed a memorandum of understanding with the CFTC. The agreements limit permissible NBA markets, bar league and team personnel from trading NBA contracts, require information sharing on suspicious trading, and give both exchanges NBA intellectual property rights and official data from Sportradar to settle authorized markets. ([CDC Gaming](https://cdcgaming.com/nba-takes-sides-in-prediction-market-fight-with-kalshi-and-polymarket-deals/))

items.title: Polymarket US logs record 74 million trades in October, CryptoBriefing reports
items.content_text: - **Polymarket US logs record 74 million trades in October, CryptoBriefing reports** — Polymarket US processed more than 74 million trades in October, a 15 percent jump from September, with monthly active traders reaching an all-time high of approximately 478,000. Sports drove the surge, with NFL and college football leading and combo and parlay-style contracts launched in August accounting for more than 50 percent of activity in some weeks, while one October week recorded 2.82 billion dollars in notional volume. ([CryptoBriefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/polymarket-us-record-74-million-trades-october/))

items.title: Prediction markets need one federal rulebook as courts split over state versus CFTC oversight, NetChoice reports
items.content_text: - **Prediction markets need one federal rulebook as courts split over state versus CFTC oversight, NetChoice reports** — NetChoice argues prediction markets need a single federal rulebook, noting CNN and CNBC now carry Kalshi data on election night and federal courts are divided over whether the markets are financial markets overseen by Washington or gambling regulated by each state. The Supreme Court has been asked to decide, and Pew Research Center found monthly volume on the two largest platforms grew more than fivefold between September 2025 and April 2026. ([NetChoice](https://netchoice.org/prediction-markets-need-one-rulebook/))

items.title: Canada draws a narrow lane for prediction markets under CIRO rules, BitcoinCasinos reports
items.content_text: - **Canada draws a narrow lane for prediction markets under CIRO rules, BitcoinCasinos reports** — Under joint guidance from CIRO and the Canadian Securities Administrators issued August 27, authorized Canadian dealers may offer event contracts tied only to economic forecasts, environmental indicators and financial markets with a minimum 30-day maturity, while contracts on elections and other political outcomes remain prohibited. Wealthsimple and Interactive Brokers Canada are the only CIRO dealer members authorized to offer such contracts, and offshore platforms such as Polymarket sit entirely outside that perimeter. items.content_text: - **CFTC tells Novig and ProphetX to hold off on micro sports event contracts, iGamingWorld reports** — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission sent communications to Novig and ProphetX instructing both registered exchanges to hold off on listing certain sports prediction markets, including planned micro event contracts such as which player will score first.
